QuestInfo.name: [Twilight Perion] To the Other Side of the Vision
QuestInfo.0: You helped the #bSorcerer#k in the Road to Oblivion. Now receive the Oblivion Essence.
QuestInfo.1:
The Sorcerer handed you an orb containing the Oblivion Essence. Take it to #bBehind the Dream#k, through Six Path Crossway Ruins. 

#e#rIf you lose the Oblivion Essence, forfeit the quest and then start it again.
QuestInfo.2: You met the Rememberer and spread out the Fog of Oblivion. Now the nightmare will fade from memory. Sweet dreams to everyone.

0.0: This orb contains Oblivion Essence refined at the highest quality. You'll get the desired effect with this amount. Take it.

0.msg: (The Sorcerer's given me the Oblivion Essence I need. I should go back to Behind the Dream and find the Rememberer.)

no.0: What? Don't you need the Oblivion Essence? Fine, I'll keep it, then.
